# Support

If you need help with **轻净 LiteClean**, please use one of the following channels:

## Bug Reports

Open a GitHub issue:
<https://github.com/xinpai/LiteClean/issues>

Please include your Windows version, the 轻净 LiteClean version (see the title bar or
the About page), and the log file.

## Feature Requests

Open a GitHub issue with a detailed description of what you would like to see, and why
it would be useful.

## Questions

Open a GitHub issue, or send an email to [164467616@qq.com](mailto:164467616@qq.com).

Before opening an issue, please check the [README](../README.md) — it documents how to
build the project and where to obtain the source code.

## Translations

Found a translation mistake or want to add a language? Open an issue or a pull request.
Translation files live in `optimizerDuck/Resources/Languages/`.

## About the upstream project

轻净 LiteClean is a modified version of
[optimizerDuck](https://github.com/itsfatduck/optimizerDuck), Copyright (C) 2025–2026
fatDuck (itsfatduck). If your question concerns the **original** project rather than this
fork, please use the upstream repository instead.

## Donations

This fork does not solicit donations. If you would like to support the original author
of optimizerDuck, please visit the upstream repository.
